configurePresets.name: msvc-client
configurePresets.description: Native Windows cod2_win32.exe via cl.exe. Run from an x86 Native Tools for VS command prompt.

configurePresets.name: msvc-client-release
configurePresets.description: Optimized native Windows cod2_win32.exe. Add -DCOD2_SDL2_STATIC=ON for an optimized standalone exe. NOTE: /O2 on decompiler-faithful code is less battle-tested than the Debug build. Run from an x86 Native Tools for VS command prompt.

configurePresets.name: msvc-client-x64
configurePresets.displayName: Windows MSVC client (x64 port, Ninja, Debug) -- COMPILE ONLY
configurePresets.description: IN-PROGRESS x86_64 port. Compiles the engine source set (cod2_msvc_objs) under the x64 cl to measure the x64 error surface; does NOT link/run yet (needs the Stage 2 typed-data migration). Run from an x64 Native Tools for VS command prompt.
